youtube.title: Inter's greatest captain ever: Zanetti or Bergomi? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Inter's greatest captain ever — Zanetti or Bergomi? We picked Zanetti. Your turn.
The Italian Inter press in English every morning, free: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate3

THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.
Javier Zanetti (1995–2014): 858 Inter games, the club record; captain from 2001 to 2014, 13 years; 16 trophies with Inter, 15 of them as captain, including the 2010 treble; wore the armband in the Champions League final in Madrid in his 700th Inter game.
Giuseppe Bergomi (1979–99): 756 Inter games in 20 seasons and never another club; debut at 16 years and 39 days, the youngest in Inter history; captain through the 1990s; one Scudetto (1988–89) and three UEFA Cups (1991, 1994, 1998).
Giacinto Facchetti (1960–78): 634 Inter games and 75 goals; four Scudetti, two European Cups, two Intercontinental Cups, one Coppa Italia; captained Italy 70 times; Inter retired his number 3.
Sandro Mazzola (1942–2026; Inter 1960–77): 565 Inter games in 17 seasons; four Scudetti, two European Cups, two Intercontinental Cups; two goals in the 1964 European Cup final.
Samir Handanovič (2012–23): 455 Inter games; captain 2019–23; one Scudetto, two Coppa Italia, two Supercoppa.
Lautaro Martínez (2018–): captain since 2023; three Scudetti, two of them as captain (2023–24 and 2025–26); 381 games and 179 goals on inter.it's player page, read Oct. 7, 2026.
For the record: sources differ on when Bergomi took the armband (1989 or 1992), so the video says only "the 1990s". Zanetti's 15 is his 16 Inter trophies minus the 1998 UEFA Cup, won before he was captain.
Sources: inter.it (Hall of Fame, news archive, player pages), Wikipedia, goal.com, forzaitalianfootball.com.
Fan-made — not affiliated with FC Internazionale Milano.

verification: Zanetti: 858 appearances, 13 years as captain and 16 trophies are inter.it's Hall of Fame figures. '15 trophies as captain' is en.wikipedia's statement ('15 of which came under his captaincy'), confirmed by forzaitalianfootball.com's list (1 CL, 5 Scudetti, 4 Coppa Italia, 4 Supercoppa, 1 Club World Cup) and by arithmetic: 16 minus the 1998 UEFA Cup, won before he took the armband in 2001.
Zanetti's years as captain: inter.it says 13 (2001 to 2014); goal.com says 14 (it counts both end years). inter.it used.
inter.it's Zanetti bio notes he was absent for the 2005 Coppa Italia, so the copy says trophies 'as captain' and never 'lifted 15'.

Bergomi's captaincy dates are DISPUTED and therefore not on any frame: en.wikipedia's club-captains list says 1992–99, forzaitalianfootball.com says 1989–99, inter.it gives none. On screen: 'Inter captain in the 1990s' (true under both); no 'years as captain' row for him.
Bergomi appearances: inter.it 756; en.wikipedia's article text says 754. inter.it used.

Bergomi trophy total is DISPUTED (inter.it stats box 7; inter.it prose and Wikipedia list 6) and is not shown. Scudetti (1, 1988–89) and UEFA Cups (3: 1991, 1994, 1998) agree in every source and are the versus rows.

Bergomi's era is written 1979–99 (first to last season; his debut was Jan. 30, 1980, in the 1979–80 Coppa Italia). 'Seasons at Inter' 19 v 20: Zanetti 1995–96 to 2013–14, Bergomi 1979–80 to 1998–99 (inter.it: 'vent'anni').

Facchetti's captaincy is DISPUTED (en.wikipedia: club captain only in 1977–78; forzaitalianfootball.com: 1966–78) — no captaincy dates for him anywhere; the lineup shows playing years for all six. His appearances: inter.it 634, en.wikipedia article text 629; inter.it used, description only.

Mazzola's goals are DISPUTED inside inter.it itself (Hall of Fame 161; the club's memorial and Wikipedia 158) — no Mazzola goal figure anywhere. Inter published its memorial for him in September 2026; the description gives his years as 1942–2026 and nothing else about it.

Lautaro's totals move weekly: 381 games and 179 goals is inter.it's player page as read Oct. 7, 2026, used only in the YouTube description with that date. 'Two Scudetti as captain' is inter.it's own wording (May 7, 2026).
The versus is level at two rows each by design; the pick rests on the case card (15 trophies as captain, 13 years, the treble).

Voice: no FIX additions this week — Facchetti, Mazzola, Bergomi (stress on the first syllable) and Zanetti came out of the Italian G2P correctly; Handanovič, Lautaro, Inter and Nerazzurri were already in FIX. 'UEFA Cups' is on screen but the voice says 'European trophies' (the English phonemizer reads UEFA as 'yoofa').
